quantile_provenance.declared_rule: exact split-conformal rank, UNCLAMPED: eps = rho_(k), k = ceil((n_cal+1)(1-alpha)). If k > n_cal the rule is infeasible and kga.certificate.split_conformal_rank_radius returns +inf (forced ABSTAIN). At alpha=0.10 the feasibility threshold is n_cal >= 9.
quantile_provenance.clamp_status: The old k = min(n_cal, ceil((n_cal+1)(1-alpha))) clamp is REMOVED from the claimed rule. It attains only n_cal/(n_cal+1) < 1-alpha. It survives in the library solely as the opt-in replay flag on_infeasible='clamp'. It is not used for any number in this manifest, and it is never binding at any n that occurs in the paper (n=9 -> k=9, n=12 -> k=12, n=18 -> k=18, n=27 -> k=26, n=135 -> k=123, n=432 -> k=390).
quantile_provenance.pool: leave-one-out-of-pool: cell i's radius excludes cell i's own residual (kga.certificate.conformal_radii_loo). Split-calibrated natural-shift tracks satisfy this by construction. Exception: the n=9 Camelyon17 per-seed pools of the paper's tab:multiseed, where the leave-one-out pool has 8 residuals and k=9 > 8, so leave-one-out is infeasible and those cells are scored in-pool with FA_u structurally 0.
quantile_provenance.archived_benchmarks: interpolated empirical residual quantile np.quantile(rho, 1-alpha); superseded, values kept in *_interpolated_superseded fields where they were previously published.
quantile_provenance.stress_grid: leave-one-condition-out cross-fitted empirical residual calibration; a jackknife, NOT exact split conformal, so coverage on the grids is empirical.

decision_accounting_summary.fa_u_identity: Under IN-SAMPLE rank calibration the miscoverage count is identically n-k, so FA_u <= (n-k)/n holds for any data: 0.0972 at n=432, 0.0370 at n=27, and exactly 0 at n in {9,12,18} where k=n. Under the promoted leave-one-out-of-pool calibration this identity does not hold, which is why the ImageNet-C SAR count is 1 and not 0.
